extracted.name: Kulfi
extracted.description: Kulfi is a delicious Indian ice cream dessert flavored with cardamon; this recipe is easy to make with condensed and evaporated milk and whipped topping.
ingredient_lines: 1 (16 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed
4 slices white bread, torn into pieces
instruction_lines: Combine evaporated milk, condensed milk, and whipped topping in a blender and blend in pieces of bread until smooth.
Pour mixture into a 9x13-inch baking dish or two plastic ice cube trays, sprinkle with cardamom.
